messages:
Aisha: Hey team — quick help needed. Baking sourdough tonight and want a 20–30 minute episode or short film plus one song to keep me focused. Cozy / slightly nostalgic. Any recs?
Tom: 'Ramy' S1E2 is ~25m, gentle and funny. Song: 'The War on Drugs \u2014 Red Eyes' (mid-tempo) :bread:
Ravi: For something super short+sweet, try The New Yorker video shorts or random indie short films (~1520m). Song: 'Fleet Foxes \u2014 Helplessness Blues' if you want warm harmonies.
Eve: I second 'Ramy' or 'Modern Love' S1 episodes (each ~30m). Also a nice YouTube short film called "Cafe Little" is ~18m. Song: 'Neko Case \u2014 Star Witness' (vibe)
SourdoughBot: Auto-playlist 'Warm Oven' queued: https://open.spotify.com/playlist/warmoven_sample (sample: 'Beirut \u2014 Nantes') :robot_face:
Aisha: Loving these. Any short foreign film recs? Prefer no subtitles if possible.
Tom: 'The Lunchbox' is longer but feels like a soft 100m. For short, check out a 20m Portuguese short called 'Allago' (may have subs). If you want no subs: music video/short visual playlists — e.g., Gorillaz clips + listen to 'Gorillaz \u2014 Empire Ants'.
Ravi: Quick poll: 'Ramy' vs 'Modern Love' vs 'Indie short'. React with :one: :two: :three: 
Eve: Voted :one: — Ramy for the quiet awkward comfort.
Aisha: Going to try Modern Love S1E3 (30m) and 'Beirut \u2014 Nantes' while kneading. Thank you! :sparkles:
